geographies.name: Kasumbalesa corridor
geographies.description: Road corridor from the Copperbelt (T3) through the Kasumbalesa border post to Katanga in the DRC.

geographies.name: Lobito corridor
geographies.description: Rail and road corridor from the Copperbelt and North-Western Province through Jimbe to the port of Lobito in Angola. Includes the Zambia-Lobito greenfield rail line and the Mwinilunga-Jimbe (T5) road.

geographies.name: Dar es Salaam corridor
geographies.description: TAZARA railway, TAZAMA pipeline and the T2 road through Nakonde and Tunduma to the port of Dar es Salaam.

geographies.name: Chirundu-Beitbridge corridor
geographies.description: Regional road corridor from Lusaka through the Chirundu one-stop border post and Zimbabwe to South Africa.

geographies.name: Trans-Caprivi corridor
geographies.description: Road corridor through the Katima Mulilo bridge at Sesheke to Namibia.

deal_types.name: Fuel supply contract
deal_types.description: A contract to supply diesel or other fuel to a site, a contractor or a fleet. This is the main opportunity type for Strata.

deal_types.name: Haulage contract
deal_types.description: A contract to move ore, concentrate, cathode, coal, crops, fuel or other bulk goods by road or rail. The haulage contractor usually buys the fuel.

deal_types.name: Contract mining
deal_types.description: A contract for load and haul, drill and blast, or waste stripping at a mine. The mining contractor usually buys the fuel.

deal_types.name: EPC contract
deal_types.description: An engineering, procurement and construction contract for a mine, plant, power station, pipeline or other facility.

deal_types.name: Construction contract
deal_types.description: A civil works contract, for example a road, rail line, dam, border post or building, that is not a full EPC contract.

deal_types.name: Tender
deal_types.description: An open invitation to bid or request for proposals from a procuring entity or a company.

deal_types.name: Expression of interest
deal_types.description: A call for expressions of interest or a request for information that comes before a tender.

deal_types.name: Prequalification
deal_types.description: A prequalification notice or a supplier or vendor registration window. Only suppliers on the list can bid later.

deal_types.name: Fleet purchase
deal_types.description: A purchase or lease of haul trucks, mining equipment, locomotives, wagons or generator sets that will need fuel.

deal_types.name: Power supply
deal_types.description: A power purchase agreement, a grid supply change or a standby generation need at a site. It can change diesel demand for generators.

deal_types.name: Equipment rental
deal_types.description: Hire of plant, generators or vehicles for a project. The renter or the hirer can buy the fuel.

deal_types.name: Other
deal_types.description: A commercial opportunity that fits no other deal type. The Classifier must give a reason.

briefs.yaml:
# Monitoring Brief v1: Zambia mining and industrials
#
# Origin: the Argo snapshot files were not in the repository and not on this host.
# This brief comes from public research with WebSearch on 2026-09-26.
# The research notes are in reports/notes/research-brief.md.
#
# Rules for this file:
# 1. Every URL comes from a WebSearch result. A "derived" URL is the root or the section
#    of a domain that appeared in a result. Its verification text says so.
# 2. Every coordinate comes from a search result that showed it. Where no result showed a
#    coordinate, geometry is null. Nobody estimated a coordinate.
# 3. The build environment blocks direct fetches. No source is verified as reachable.
#    The collector must confirm each source on its first run.
# 4. No terms of use were read. Every source other than Google News has the licence code
#    verify_then_purge until Mohamed sets it (docs/assumptions.md, row 5).
# 5. A site entry can have two optional fields: "corridor" (a corridor code from
#    config/taxonomy/geographies.yaml) and "note" (research context for a reviewer).
# 6. status_hint "producing" means "in operation" for power, industrial, transport,
#    border and fuel_supply sites.

    keywords: ["restart", "reopen", "resume production", "dewatering", "recapitalisation"]

    keywords: ["exploration licence", "drilling programme", "drill results", "mineral resource estimate", "JORC", "NI 43-101"]

briefs.yaml:
# Monitoring Brief v1: Zambia mining and industrials
#
# Origin: the Argo snapshot files were not in the repository and not on this host.
# This brief comes from public research with WebSearch on 2026-09-26.
# The research notes are in reports/notes/research-brief.md.
#
# Rules for this file:
# 1. Every URL comes from a WebSearch result. A "derived" URL is the root or the section
#    of a domain that appeared in a result. Its verification text says so.
# 2. Every coordinate comes from a search result that showed it. Where no result showed a
#    coordinate, geometry is null. Nobody estimated a coordinate.
# 3. The build environment blocks direct fetches. No source is verified as reachable.
#    The collector must confirm each source on its first run.
# 4. No terms of use were read. Every source other than Google News has the licence code
#    verify_then_purge until Mohamed sets it (docs/assumptions.md, row 5).
# 5. A site entry can have two optional fields: "corridor" (a corridor code from
#    config/taxonomy/geographies.yaml) and "note" (research context for a reviewer).
# 6. status_hint "producing" means "in operation" for power, industrial, transport,
#    border and fuel_supply sites.
